A Tourist without Wizard Antimagic equipment creates a hostile Angel in debug mode, reveals the map, and rests with m-prefixed no-ops until its adjacent innate magic-missile attack. The starting square remains unengraved, so the discarded zap.c:mon_spell_hits_spot call takes its no-engraving path. Seed, date, role, race, character name, and command sequence were selected independently of the admitted v54 challenge.
